notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.73

• Typing is smooth again: the keyboard runs on its own, so it no longer stalls the app you type into — and opening a note no longer freezes the phone.
• To Do is new: My Day, Important, Planned, your own lists, and a little celebration when you finish a task.
• Clock, Weather and DuckOffice are laid out for a phone.
• Games fill the screen; Snake and Tetris are steered by swiping.
• Camera: a PRO mode (ISO, shutter, white balance, focus by hand) and its buttons sit below the status bar.
• DuckAI answers "brightness lower", "make it brighter", "dim the screen" at once, and closes with the glow sinking away.
• Choosing a picture (Bug Report, wallpaper, DuckOffice, the web apps) is DuckOS's own picker now.
• Settings › Notifications: every app's notifications, DuckOS's own pages — on/off and each kind of notification.
• Medical ID is quicker to fill in: date of birth and age, height and weight with units, contacts from Contacts, saved as you type.
• Bug Report lives in Settings and stays open after sending. DuckMaps sits under the status bar, Find My lost its zoom buttons, app icons are centred, "The home screen is full" is fixed.
• DuckConnections: Lock only for PCs, and a proper sign-out sheet.
